description: This file defines the `NumberHelperService` class which provides utility methods for formatting numbers, including `numberFormat` and `numberFormatWithGroupedThousands`. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Core Service namespace.

classes.name: NumberHelperService
classes.description: A service class providing number formatting utilities, such as formatting numbers with decimal points and grouped thousands.

methods.name: numberFormat
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimal points, using '.' as decimal separator and no thousands separator.

methods.name: numberFormatWithGroupedThousands
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimal points and an optional thousands separator (default ',').
